resources.string: Use the selected DoH resolver for public DNS even when an exit node is active. MagicDNS and split DNS remain controlled by Tailscale.
Dial the selected DoH resolver using Tailscale route-aware dialing, so the DoH connection can follow an active exit node when routes allow it.
Use the DNS resolvers from Tailscale policy, exit-node DNS, or the underlying system configuration.

A custom endpoint is honored in full by Multi-Tailnet mode. In Standard mode, only known providers from the list above are accepted, since Tailscale needs to reach the resolver without first depending on DNS to do so.
